summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Green Circle Decarbonize Technology Ltd, a foreign private issuer, reporting a private placement of $10 million principal amount of unsecured promissory notes at an $8 million subscription price (i.e., OID), with common warrants to buy up to 29,122,679 shares at $2.00 per share. The offering is exempt from registration and includes lock-up agreements for 90 days. This is a routine capital-raising event, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
